# Marketing Dashboard

This dashboard shows my ability to organize data, create visual summaries, and communicate insights in a clear way.

The goal of this page is to demonstrate how marketing data can be used to understand audience behavior, engagement, and performance trends.

---

## Dashboard Purpose

A dashboard helps marketers quickly understand what is working and what needs improvement. For this project, I focused on simple performance indicators that could be useful in a campaign or digital marketing setting.

---

## Key Metrics

| Metric | What It Shows |
|---|---|
| Engagement | How much the audience interacts with content |
| Reach | How many people saw the campaign or post |
| Audience Interest | What type of content performs best |
| Performance Trend | Whether results improved or decreased over time |

---

## Sample Dashboard Insight

Based on the sample analysis, content that feels more personal, visual, and community-focused tends to create stronger engagement. This matters because marketing is not just about posting content, but about understanding what the audience responds to.

---

## Tools Used

- Quarto  
- R  
- ggplot2  
- Excel  
- Data Visualization  
- Marketing Analytics  

---

## Reflection

This dashboard helped me practice turning information into visuals and short insights. It also helped me understand how marketers can use data to make better campaign decisions.
